exposure: spontaneous twin anemia polycythemia sequence (sTAPS) diagnosis
normal monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) twin pregnancy diagnosis
outcome: Total diameter of all vascular anastomoses
Ratio between distance of two umbilical cord insertion points and placental maximum diameter
cohort: The study participants were monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies categorized into spontaneous twin anemia polycythemia sequence, twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome, and normal pregnancies.
finding: In spontaneous twin anemia polycythemia sequence placentas, the number of superficial vascular anastomoses is lower, their diameter is smaller, and the distance between the two umbilical cord insertion points is longer.
